objective: All 42 proposals implemented/evaluated; retain correct reductions in decisions or repeated reasoning, also measure time; publish validated release.
evidence_stage: finite development evidence; final frozen-source release evidence added separately
default_policy: New controls are opt-in; no all-options-on recommendation.

candidates.mechanism: Save unfinished cut-vector enumeration and its private support union; publish a deduction only when the required alternatives finish.
candidates.finite_evidence: A finite continuation check uses 5 matching checks instead of 8; interruption at every tested checkpoint preserves the exact result.
candidates.limits: This resumes selected cut reasoning, not every CPU propagator. Direct regional diagrams additionally retain same-process construction sessions (#17).
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.proposal: Prune queued frontier with verified exclusions
candidates.access: queue_pruning; parallel-dfs, or dfs with shared_coverage
candidates.mechanism: Subtract independently verified exclusions from queued domain boxes before launching workers. Exact splitting preserves the remaining disjoint union.
candidates.finite_evidence: A verified loop excludes a queued job with zero workers started; randomized box subtraction agrees with explicit assignments.
candidates.limits: Active worker jobs retain their own ownership; a size cap leaves the previous pending cover unchanged.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.access: shared_coverage; dfs, parallel-dfs, persistent SAT, gpu-domains
candidates.mechanism: Store completed infeasible boxes in a scoped SQLite ledger and subtract them when changing compatible policies or engines.
candidates.finite_evidence: Restart and policy-change checks avoid executing completed work; objective/root mismatch and incomplete/solved entries are rejected.
candidates.limits: Trusted local progress is not a portable mathematical proof. A completed imported subset does not establish exhaustion of the entire puzzle.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Export the exact unfinished union as disjoint domain boxes; import it into parallel DFS, persistent SAT or CUDA domains.
candidates.finite_evidence: CPU/SAT and CPU/GPU/CPU round trips preserve unfinished work; overlap, scope and corruption checks reject invalid inputs.
candidates.limits: Native internal trails or SAT clauses may be rebuilt after transfer. The compact legacy GPU engine is not a general receiver for this format.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.disposition: Retained checked transport; bounded proof producer
candidates.mechanism: Produce bounded edge-model DPLL refutations and independently check their RUP clauses before accepting transported mask exclusions.
candidates.finite_evidence: A checked certificate avoids native SAT re-solving; altered proofs/scope fail validation. A child-process test checks clean exit after UNSAT proof generation.
candidates.limits: Gold-only contradictions outside the edge relaxation still need ordinary verification. Native proof logging was rejected after a Windows crash; the pure bounded producer is used.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Keep one plain-SAT model, learned native state and guarded cube assumptions across warm slices; checkpoint remaining cubes and verified Gold cuts.
candidates.finite_evidence: Warm slices build the model once; completed cubes stay absent after restart; independently enumerated edge/Gold fixtures agree.
candidates.limits: Process restart rebuilds native SAT internals and may repeat unfinished inference. This is plain SAT, not a portable checkpoint for every SAT/CP backend.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Revalidate complete semantic SAT models in new domain contexts, supplying many placement supports without another solver query.
candidates.finite_evidence: On 60 finite contexts, identical supported domains require 72 native calls versus 874 for the prior scan.
candidates.limits: These are edge-relaxation support witnesses; they are not accepted as Gold solutions. The pool and retained work are bounded.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Reuse completed negative results when live domains, inventory, exposed masks and contracted path wiring describe the same remaining problem.
candidates.finite_evidence: Equivalent fixed interiors share a key; the public DFS path reuses a completed proof before propagation. Timeout and wrong-root reuse cannot create exclusions.
candidates.limits: Actual cell/piece labels remain. Arbitrary graph isomorphism and physical-piece renaming are not implemented; reuse is bound to the owned root.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Repair the piece matching and revisit only affected alternating-graph SCCs when the matching stays valid; reuse exact saved snapshots on rollback.
candidates.finite_evidence: Random shrink/widen/backtrack sequences match exhaustive assignments. One six-cell example revisits 2 SCC vertices and reuses 4.
candidates.limits: Matching changes or unrecognized widening trigger a complete pass. Interrupted partial computations are not committed.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Maintain reversible per-lane strand connectivity through assignments and undo operations.
candidates.finite_evidence: Complete tiny Gold solution sets agree with rebuilding connectivity, with fewer strand joins.
candidates.limits: NVIDIA CUDA domain engine only; this does not add full reversible state to the compact WebGPU engine.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Keep scoped binary path-consistency deductions so later domain restrictions can expose their unary consequences.
candidates.finite_evidence: An initially non-pruning equality relation later forces its partner; independent enumeration checks narrower/wider contexts.
candidates.limits: Current extraction is from path consistency, not every constructive-lookahead or SAT relation.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Query a guarded disjunction of uncovered placements and use each returned model to cover multiple supports.
candidates.finite_evidence: One fixture needs 11 calls versus 20; the wider 60-context corpus needs 965 versus 874. With witness pooling both use 72.
candidates.limits: Retained as a selectable alternative, not a universal improvement. Selectors are disabled on completion or interruption.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Solve simultaneous seam-signature capacity constraints with exact matching and support filtering.
candidates.finite_evidence: A joint shortage passes separate class bounds but fails the combined model; 400 small instances match independent assignments.
candidates.limits: No additional pruning after the prior fixpoint on the 60-context comparison corpus. Original-board benefit remains unestablished.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Combine affine port-vector constraints in global seam coordinates and reject inconsistent candidates.
candidates.finite_evidence: All 256 subsets of three-bit vectors match independent affine closure; 80 puzzle contexts preserve all enumerated edge solutions.
candidates.limits: Runtime propagation uses GF(2). A mod-3 reference experiment exists, but general modular runtime propagation is not implemented; the comparison corpus found no extra pruning.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Derive exact pseudo-Boolean capacity/seam inequalities through positive integer combinations and gcd rounding, then filter domains.
candidates.finite_evidence: A contradiction survives primitive rows but is caught by a derived cut; 80 signed-integer systems preserve their complete model sets.
candidates.limits: Derived cuts are bounded and checked. The 60-context prior-fixpoint comparison found no additional deletion.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Explain partial Hall shortages and bounded affine consequences to the native SAT backend.
candidates.finite_evidence: A partial shortage clause holds for every independently enumerated edge solution.
candidates.limits: This adds specific theory propagators, not the entire CPU pruning pipeline; it requires the compatible native SAT environment.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Compile exact labelled regional histories directly into a memoized frontier DAG and join overlapping DAGs without expanding all rows.
candidates.finite_evidence: The seven-cell discriminator preserves all 5,040 histories with 889 versus 60,620 candidate trials; sliced construction repeats no trials.
candidates.limits: Selected regions and hard state/work caps apply. Unfinished DAG sessions survive only in the same process, not as portable disk continuations.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Represent used-piece subsets with a ZDD and compute exact disjoint products and inventory supports.
candidates.finite_evidence: Six regional groups retain the same 66 inventories each; 19,033 ZDD primitive operations replace 135,102 explicit inventory alternatives in the discriminator.
candidates.limits: Primitive operation types differ, so this is not a speed ratio. Node caps yield unknown without eliminating support.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Eliminate seam/piece factors with inward/outward support messages, forgetting each resource only after its final possible occurrence; provide exact cutset conditioning.
candidates.finite_evidence: A synthetic 160-cell resource fixture uses 2,080 factor operations at live width 2; independently validated full witnesses cover every retained placement.
candidates.limits: Full mode covers all cells for seams and inventory. Gold connectivity remains outside this relaxation. Wide original instances can cap; small selected queries are not a full-board completion proof.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Split oversized elimination buckets into optimistic subproblems whose completed negatives remain sound.
candidates.finite_evidence: The bounded K4 three-colour discriminator is possible at width 3 and rejected at width 4.
candidates.limits: A feasible relaxation is not a solution; budget limits return unknown. Benefit depends on the chosen width and residual graph.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Merge states by unioning possibilities, then refine still-possible queries through increasing widths.
candidates.finite_evidence: An odd-XOR triangle survives width 1 and is rejected after refinement; exhaustive checks preserve true solutions.
candidates.limits: Merging is optimistic. Only a completed negative or exact result can justify a conclusion; caps are unknown.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Use a GF(2) rank basis of connectivity rows inside the same inventory/boundary class.
candidates.finite_evidence: 105 eight-endpoint matching rows reduce to 8 representatives, checked against all 105 outside matchings.
candidates.limits: Preserves existence, not counts or arbitrary placement supports. Reduction is limited to ten exposed endpoints; larger classes keep all rows.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Use exact integer ranked subset convolution for disjoint inventory joins, evaluating only cardinality layers present.
candidates.finite_evidence: A ten-piece join replaces 63,504 explicit pair tests with 16,384 transform operations and preserves all 252 joined histories.
candidates.limits: Different operation types are not directly comparable in time. The generic transform accepts at most 16 pieces; integrated queries default to ten.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Generate regional realizations on demand and memoize only completed failed inventory/strand interfaces.
candidates.finite_evidence: An eight-cell discriminator requests 2 local rows instead of preparing 3,360 eager rows and returns independently validated Gold.
candidates.limits: This is a bounded existence query, not a general full-size branch-and-price engine. Capped parent interfaces are never marked failed.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Eliminate interior variables from optimistic regional CNF and replay each resolution derivation before retaining interface clauses.
candidates.finite_evidence: 100 finite formulas preserve existential boundary models; puzzle checks preserve every enumerated completion under narrower contexts.
candidates.limits: Caps publish no formula; widening invalidates scoped use. Arbitrary backend Craig-interpolant extraction is not implemented.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Accept LP negatives only after exact rational Farkas checks; a separate regional DAG pricing prototype generates inventory columns on demand.
candidates.finite_evidence: A feasible inventory master generates 24 columns from 90 histories; a shortage closes only after complete pricing and exact certification.
candidates.limits: The pricing master relaxes seams/Gold connectivity, and feasible LPs are not witnesses. Native LP proposals are optional and never proof authority.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Require simultaneous port-disjoint routes with compatible orientation and physical-piece labels.
candidates.finite_evidence: Individual routes exist in a discriminator but cannot coexist with consistent labels; exhaustive small puzzle cases retain every Gold solution.
candidates.limits: A Gold-only necessary condition with query/admission caps, not a general complete routing solver for arbitrary large residual boards.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Branch on whether a selected physical piece occupies a cell, partitioning that cell domain into present/absent masks.
candidates.finite_evidence: Every independently enumerated completion belongs to exactly one child.
candidates.limits: Completeness is preserved; fewer total decisions on the original puzzle is unestablished.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Partition by continuation of a fixed strand into a neighbouring tile, including alternatives with identical seam masks.
candidates.finite_evidence: A discriminator distinguishes internal partners even when side masks agree; child masks cover the original domain exactly.
candidates.limits: This changes the order/partition of exact work, not the feasibility conditions.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Count exact local seam/inventory extensions in a small star and use completed counts to rank values.
candidates.finite_evidence: Counts agree with independent local enumeration; a capped count still retains every choice.
candidates.limits: Local counts are a relaxation of the whole board. They never remove candidates or imply a global completion count.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.disposition: Retained optional fitted ordering; limited evidence
candidates.mechanism: Use frozen five-feature ridge weights trained on completed child-search work to order values.
candidates.finite_evidence: 46 completed labels on six training seeds; twelve disjoint ten-cell tests use 119 versus 133 nodes, with 7 wins, 2 ties and 3 losses.
candidates.limits: Six further forty-cell pairs all cap and remain inconclusive. No original-board generalization or learned repair policy is claimed; predictions never prune.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Mine mixed seam/inventory incompatibility cliques and odd cycles, then verify their exact at-most bounds.
candidates.finite_evidence: Generated rules are rechecked; 45 puzzle contexts preserve every enumerated edge solution. Dominated rules do not inflate retained-rule counts.
candidates.limits: Discovery is limited to these templates; no unrestricted theorem synthesis. No additional pruning in the 60-context prior-fixpoint comparison.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Keep lane-local reasons and learned placement clauses; jump back to the relevant decision rather than undoing every intervening choice.
candidates.finite_evidence: A completed Hall UNSAT fixture uses 42 decisions/757 support checks with learning versus 166/2,852 without.
candidates.limits: Clauses are scoped to their lane root. This is the new CUDA domain architecture, not a change to every legacy GPU lane.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Store complete reversible domains, removals, reasons and unfinished propagation scans in durable lane state.
candidates.finite_evidence: Tiny exhaustive comparisons and checkpoint/restore tests preserve pending work; 160-cell-deep fixtures check remaining branch volumes.
candidates.limits: The full-state engine supports 128–512 lanes within its memory budget, not 131,072. Batch lanes are not yet refilled dynamically.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Rank bounded CPU probes by signs of a physical-piece shortage, then require the CPU to prove failure independently.
candidates.finite_evidence: A 160-cell discriminator selects four cells competing for three pieces; the selected query proves infeasible.
candidates.limits: Ranking alone never rejects a branch; this extends CPU assistance for the compact GPU DFS engine.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Use infeasible assumption cores and an exact hitting-set master to seek a minimum number of changed cells.
candidates.finite_evidence: Tiny complete enumeration confirms the minimum Hamming distance; cancellation and invalid seed assumptions are checked.
candidates.limits: Minimum-change claims require completed optimization. Budget exhaustion and unavailable native dependencies are unknown.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Enumerate exact patch trades preserving all outside placements while seeking fewer loop components.
candidates.finite_evidence: A two-cell trade merges three loops into independently validated Gold.
candidates.limits: Requires an edge-perfect legal input; it does not make a failed patch proof apply to other outside arrangements.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Pack compatible matched fragments from an archive, then complete physical inventory and the Gold circuit exactly.
candidates.finite_evidence: A small crossover uses material from both parents and independently validates its Gold result.
candidates.limits: Bounded archive/fragment/query sizes apply. This is a proposal heuristic followed by exact validation, not exhaustive global coverage.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Record completed feasibility failures under explicit outside assumptions; send candidate exclusions through independent original-root verification.
candidates.finite_evidence: A transport discriminator offers one true and one false claim; only the true exclusion is admitted.
candidates.limits: Optimization failure, a capped query or an unverified exported core cannot prune DFS.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Propose closed three-to-six-cell relocation chains with independent rotations.
candidates.finite_evidence: All nonempty combinations of the three new sampling controls preserve inventory/fixed cells and independently recalculated scores on CUDA and D3D12 tests.
candidates.limits: Heuristic sampling does not prove coverage and can revisit boards. This chain path currently rescans the full score.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Keep short move-attribute tabu memory, allowing aspiration when a move improves that lane’s best.
candidates.finite_evidence: The sampling combinations pass independent current/best-board and score checks, including with Gold scoring enabled.
candidates.limits: Tabu discourages selected recent moves; it does not guarantee distinct complete boards or establish a faster original solve.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results

candidates.mechanism: Exchange current boards/scores between fixed-temperature lanes using Metropolis acceptance, keeping lane RNG/iteration and best archives in place.
candidates.finite_evidence: Equal-energy cases verify actual board exchange without moving temperature-lane state; combined sampling modes pass invariant checks.
candidates.limits: This is diversification, not an exact search-space reduction. Compare equal proposals, time and solution quality across seeds.
candidates.original_puzzle_gain: not established by these finite results
